content.fullText: In 2025, the ecosystem for Claude has matured into a powerful "agentic" workflow, moving beyond simple chat into direct system and tool interaction. The landscape is currently dominated by MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, which allow Claude to "act" rather than just "talk," and the newly introduced Claude Skills for specialized task execution.Here are the most popular tools and extensions being used right now:1. Top MCP Servers (GitHub & npm)The Model Context Protocol has become the industry standard for connecting Claude to external data and tools.Server NamePopularity / Use CaseSource / InstallGitHub MCPTop Developer Tool. Manage PRs, issues, and commits directly from the terminal.npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-githubSequential ThinkingEssential for complex problem solving. Forces Claude to use a step-by-step logic chain.npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinkingContext7Trending for RAG. Injects up-to-date, version-specific library documentation to prevent hallucinations.npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp@latestPostgreSQL / MongoDBUsed for natural language database queries. Allows Claude to safely inspect schemas and fetch data.npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgresPuppeteer / PlaywrightPopular for web automation and scraping. Claude can navigate sites and take screenshots.npx -y @anthropic-ai/playwright-mcpFigma Dev ModeThe go-to for UI/UX developers. Converts designs into production-ready React/Tailwind code.npx -y @figma/figma-dev-mode-mcpExport to Sheets2. Trending "Claude Skills"Introduced in late 2025, Skills are portable folders containing instructions and scripts that Claude loads on-demand.Document Processors: Specialized skills for handling massive PDFs, Word docs, and Excel sheets with high precision (e.g., the Docling skill by IBM).Creative Media: The slack-gif-creator is a community favorite for generating optimized animations within size constraints.Project Memory: A skill used for tracking long-term project state across different chat sessions (found in repos like project-memory).Tailwind v4 / Shadcn UI: High-demand developer skills that provide Claude with the specific constraints and components of modern CSS frameworks.3. Essential Extensions & Community ReposCommunity-driven GitHub repositories have become the "App Stores" for Claude users.Awesome MCP Servers: A massive repository (76k+ stars) acting as the central directory for all verified and community-built MCP servers.Claude Code Chat (VS Code): A popular extension that brings the native "Claude Code" terminal experience into a beautiful side-panel interface in VS Code.Claude for Chrome (Beta): The official browser extension that enables "Planning Mode" and multi-tab workflows, allowing Claude to take actions across Gmail, Slack, and GitHub simultaneously.DXT (Desktop Extensions): A new packaging format (.dxt) that allows one-click installation of MCP servers for the Claude Desktop app, removing the need for manual JSON configuration.Where to Find More:GitHub Topics: Search for claude-code-skill or mcp-server.NPM Search: Look for packages with the @modelcontextprotocol scope.Subreddits: r/ClaudeAI and r/mcp are the primary hubs for real-time community discussions and "must-have" lists.Would you like me to help you set up a specific MCP server, or perhaps find a "Claude Skill" tailored to your current project, like "语界" (Welt)?
